nodes.body: fixed lint. humanized the log message.

generalised the check per your suggestion to catch both directions (fp4 runtime with fp8 checkpoint scales, and vice versa). also ensured the filtered scales degrade perfectly to dynamic. pushed the update.

would be awesome if you could run the full harness on the 2x5060 rig to validate this end-to-end!

End to end on SM120 this fixes NVFP4 KV: the needle test at 8K to 96K goes from 6/36 to 36/36, level with the default FP8 launch.
Setup: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q, TP1, the report's checkpoint (`unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4`) and attention flags, main `4fc86f73c` with and without this head; sglang-kernel 0.4.10, FlashInfer 0.7.2, torch 2.14.1.

| KV dtype | Tree | Needle 8K to 96K | GSM8K strict | NLL, last 2K tokens of 32K windows |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| NVFP4 | main | 6/36 | 0.640 | 3.46 |
| NVFP4 | this PR | 36/36 | 0.964 | 1.82 |
| FP8 (default launch) | main | 18/18 | 0.968 | 1.82 |
| FP8 (default launch) | this PR | 18/18 | 0.972 | 1.82 |
| BF16 | main | 2/18 | 0.668 | 3.47 |
| BF16 | this PR | 18/18 | 0.960 | 1.82 |

With this PR NVFP4 is level with the default FP8 launch on all three measures, and main's BF16 row shows the same breakage.

Two gaps against chengye75-star's invariant:

1. FP8 launch: the filter runs outside the mismatch check, so the FP8 launch also gets scales of 1.0 with no warning. That is harmless on this model (the FP8 rows above).
2. BF16 KV: main also breaks BF16 KV (needle 2/18) because the FlashInfer prefill backend passes `k_scale`/`v_scale` for any KV dtype (`flashinfer_backend.py:1397`, `:1459`, `:1532` on `4fc86f73c`). The PR fixes it (18/18) only through that unconditional filter, so BF16 should count as a mismatch once the filter moves inside the check.

<details><summary>Commands</summary>

```
python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 --kv-cache-dtype {nvfp4,auto,bf16} \
  --tp 1 --context-length 131072 --page-size 64 --prefill-attention-backend flashinfer \
  --decode-attention-backend trtllm_mha --disable-prefill-cuda-graph --disable-radix-cache \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.80 --max-running-requests 32
# needle: pass key in 8K/32K/96K WikiText-2 haystacks at depth 0.1/0.5/0.9, greedy chat, thinking off
python s42419_needle.py <port> <served> <model> out.json 8192,32768,98304 0.1,0.5,0.9 2 <rounds>
# prompt logprobs, 4 windows each of 32K and 64K, last 2048 positions
python s42419_logprob.py <port> <model> out.json 32768,65536 4 2048
# chat GSM8K, 250 questions, concurrency 32
python gsm8k_chat.py <port> <served> out.json 250 32
```

</details>

The job script, the client scripts, the per-arm outputs and the probe of the filter are in https://gist.github.com/waynehacking8/6081b45e2119aace7844e2d5988a491f.

thanks for verifying on sm120. rebased on latest main and addressed both gaps: moved the filter inside the mismatch block so fp8 launches preserve checkpoint scales, and added the bf16/unquantized mismatch check so static scales get dropped for bf16 runtimes as well. added unit test coverage in `test_default_model_loader.py`.

@@ -1055,6 +1055,67 @@ def load_weights_only(model, weights, target_device):
                 for name, loaded_weight in weights
             )
 
+        try:
+            from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_model
+
+            model_bag = get_model()
+            runtime_kv_dtype = getattr(model_bag, "kv_cache_dtype", None)
+
+            kv_scheme = None
+            if quant_config is not None and hasattr(quant_config, "kv_cache_scheme"):
+                kv_scheme = quant_config.kv_cache_scheme
+            elif hasattr(model, "config") and hasattr(model.config, "hf_config"):
+                quant_cfg = getattr(model.config.hf_config, "quantization_config", None)
+                if isinstance(quant_cfg, dict):
+                    kv_scheme = quant_cfg.get("kv_cache_scheme")
+                elif hasattr(quant_cfg, "kv_cache_scheme"):
+                    kv_scheme = getattr(quant_cfg, "kv_cache_scheme", None)
+
+            if isinstance(kv_scheme, dict):
+                checkpoint_bits = kv_scheme.get("num_bits")
+                expected_bits = None
+                if runtime_kv_dtype == "auto":
+                    # configure_kv_cache_dtype resolves auto to an FP8 pool here.
+                    algo = getattr(quant_config, "kv_cache_quant_algo", None)
+                    if isinstance(algo, str) and algo.upper() == "FP8":
+                        expected_bits = 8
+                elif runtime_kv_dtype:
+                    if "fp8" in runtime_kv_dtype or "int8" in runtime_kv_dtype:
+                        expected_bits = 8
+                    elif "fp4" in runtime_kv_dtype:
+                        expected_bits = 4
+                    elif (
+                        "bf16" in runtime_kv_dtype
+                        or "bfloat16" in runtime_kv_dtype
+                        or "fp16" in runtime_kv_dtype
+                        or "float16" in runtime_kv_dtype
+                    ):
+                        expected_bits = 16
+
+                if checkpoint_bits and (
+                    expected_bits is None or checkpoint_bits != expected_bits
+                ):
+                    logger.info(
+                        "ignoring kv cache scales from checkpoint (checkpoint_bits=%s, runtime_dtype=%s). "
+                        "mismatch prevents scale corruption; falling back to dynamic scales.",
+                        checkpoint_bits,
+                        runtime_kv_dtype,
+                    )
+
+                    def _filter_kv_scales(ws):
+                        for n, w in ws:
+                            if (
+                                n.endswith("k_scale")
+                                or n.endswith("v_scale")
+                                or n.endswith("kv_scale")
+                            ):
+                                continue
+                            yield n, w
+
+                    weights = _filter_kv_scales(weights)
+        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
+            pass
+
         weights = monokernel_weights_iterator(model=model, weights=weights)
         model.load_weights(weights)
         if (is_nvfp4_online or is_modelopt_fp4_online) and target_device.type == "cuda":

@@ -129,6 +129,67 @@ def load_weights_and_postprocess(self, model, weights, target_device):
                     startup_prefetch_active=True,
                 )
 
+    def test_kv_cache_scale_dropped_on_mismatch(self):
+        cases = [
+            # (checkpoint_bits, runtime_kv_dtype, expect_scales_dropped, kv_cache_quant_algo)
+            (8, "nvfp4", True, None),
+            (8, "bfloat16", True, None),
+            (8, "fp8", False, None),
+            (8, "auto", False, "FP8"),
+            (4, "nvfp4", False, None),
+            (4, "fp8", True, None),
+        ]
+        for checkpoint_bits, runtime_dtype, expect_dropped, *extra in cases:
+            quant_algo = extra[0] if extra else None
+            with self.subTest(ckpt=checkpoint_bits, runtime=runtime_dtype):
+                model = Mock()
+                model.quant_config = SimpleNamespace(
+                    kv_cache_scheme={"num_bits": checkpoint_bits},
+                    kv_cache_quant_algo=quant_algo,
+                    is_nvfp4_online=False,
+                    get_name=lambda: "dummy",
+                )
+                loaded = []
+                model.load_weights.side_effect = lambda ws: loaded.extend(list(ws))
+
+                dummy_weights = [
+                    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight", torch.zeros(1)),
+                    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.k_scale", torch.ones(1)),
+                    ("model.layers.0.self_attn.v_scale", torch.ones(1)),
+                ]
+
+                model_bag = SimpleNamespace(kv_cache_dtype=runtime_dtype)
+                with (
+                    patch.object(loader_mod, "is_cuda_alike", return_value=False),
+                    patch(
+                        "sglang.srt.runtime_context.get_model",
+                        return_value=model_bag,
+                    ),
+                    patch.object(
+                        loader_mod,
+                        "monokernel_weights_iterator",
+                        side_effect=lambda model, weights: weights,
+                    ),
+                ):
+                    DefaultModelLoader.load_weights_only(
+                        model, iter(dummy_weights), torch.device("cpu")
+                    )
+
+                loaded_names = [name for name, _ in loaded]
+                if expect_dropped:
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        loaded_names, ["model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight"]
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        loaded_names,
+                        [
+                            "model.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+                            "model.layers.0.self_attn.k_scale",
+                            "model.layers.0.self_attn.v_scale",
+                        ],
+                    )
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
